subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The plan was very __________ and took a lot of time to develop.
solution:
The correct answer is '**elaborate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**elaborate**" means involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design and planning. (विस्तृत)
 
• The sentence suggests that the plan took a lot of time to develop, implying that it was detailed or elaborate.
 
• The other options: "**being elaborate**," "**elaborates**," and "**elaboration**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The plan was very elaborate__ and took a lot of time to develop.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Being elaborate:** Incorrect because the sentence requires an adjective, not a phrase.
 
• **Elaborates:** Incorrect because it is a verb and does not suit the sentence structure.
 
• **Elaboration:** Incorrect because it is a noun and does not fit contextually.
